Hardest-look review at 5d46fce3bea529bb73f19c3a90969b39162f680a, per Elrond's fan-out. `mergeable=CONFLICTING` - needs rebase regardless; assessing content since it needs re-review after rebase anyway.

**[1] `hq-portal/src/screens/ShellScreens.tsx#L99`**
`source_quote`: `body: "Plan, invoices, payment method"` (was `"Your plan, usage, invoices, and API key — everything about your account."`)
`failure_proof`: `approvedCopy6559.test.ts#L65` locks this string to one of two accepted exact values - "Your plan, usage, invoices, and API key — the account-level facts." or "...— everything about your account." - confirmed directly at this head. This PR's new text, "Plan, invoices, payment method", matches neither. Same shape on `SettingsPanes.tsx`'s TeamPane description against `approvedCopy6564.test.ts`. Confirmed diff vs drift: `hq-bundle` is green on main's current tip (2026-09-07T21:53:08Z) and red on this head with the exact assertion `ShellScreens.tsx is missing: Your plan, usage, invoices, and API key...`.

**[2] `hq-portal/src/screens/ShellScreens.tsx#L141`**
`source_quote`: default `pane` state changed from `"about"` to `"overview"`, but `SETTINGS_PANES` has no `"overview"` entry.
`failure_proof`: `aria-selected={pane === p.key}` and `tabIndex={pane === p.key ? 0 : -1}` (both confirmed present) mean that on the new default landing state, no tab in the sidebar has `aria-selected="true"` and none has `tabIndex={0}` - all 8 tabs are `-1`. A keyboard user tabbing into Settings on first load lands in a tablist with nothing focusable, directly contradicting the code's own comment claiming "full WAI-ARIA tabs keyboard pattern... roving tabindex." Not caught by the new `settings-mock.spec.ts`, which clicks tabs directly rather than testing initial keyboard focus - same author-missed-regression shape as sibling #7274.

**CI_STATUS**: `hq-bundle` red, diff-caused (finding 1). Separately, `test (shard 36/37/42/60)` failures are 3-day-stale infra flakes (`Failed to launch runner: Assigned instance became unavailable`) from a 2026-09-04 run, unrelated to the diff - shards 43-60 show `cancelled` from the same fail-fast cascade. Recommend a fresh test-matrix run after rebase rather than trusting this stale batch either way.

**Verdict: REQUEST_CHANGES.** Either keep the original locked copy strings or get explicit sign-off to update the approved-copy fixtures for #6559/#6564 in this same PR; fix the missing "overview" entry in `SETTINGS_PANES` (or give it a real default tab) so the tablist always has a focusable, selected tab on load.

Lane-review: changes-requested
Lane-verifier: gimli
Lane-verifier-run: gimli-pr-7277-20260907T2223Z
Lane-reviewed-head: 5d46fce3bea529bb73f19c3a90969b39162f680a
Review-disagreement: contradicted - the new overview content and teammate cues genuinely improve on the stated goal, but the PR breaks two locked copy-regression tests and silently strips keyboard-tab focusability from the very screen it's improving, neither of which the author's own new tests catch.

Reviewer: gimli-seat. Re-verified at current head `c63b13473b3d4704e3821413c78a9ed5289f19b2` - head moved since my 2026-09-07T22:20:49Z REQUEST_CHANGES at `5d46fce3bea529bb73f19c3a90969b39162f680a`, but neither finding from that review is actually resolved.

**[1] STILL UNRESOLVED - `hq-portal/src/screens/ShellScreens.tsx#L99`**: `body: "Plan, invoices, payment method"` - confirmed present verbatim at this head, still matches neither of the two strings `approvedCopy6559.test.ts`/`approvedCopy6564.test.ts` lock. This is the exact, live cause of `hq-bundle`'s current failure at this head (job 101972803192): `FAIL src/screens/approvedCopy6559.test.ts`, `FAIL src/screens/approvedCopy6564.test.ts`, "2 failed | 175 passed (177)" test files.

**[2] STILL UNRESOLVED, different shape - `ShellScreens.tsx#L166,200-249`**: the default `pane` state now falls back to `"overview"` (`#L166`) and the tab panel correctly special-cases rendering for it (`#L250`), but `SETTINGS_PANES.map(...)` (`#L218`) - which is the ONLY thing that renders `role="tab"` elements - still enumerates just the original 8 keys (about/security/connectors/team/preferences/tools/data/account). `"overview"` has no corresponding tab entry, so `aria-selected={pane === p.key}` and `tabIndex={pane === p.key ? 0 : -1}` are false/-1 for every rendered tab when `pane === "overview"` (the new default). A keyboard user landing on Settings still tabs into a tablist with nothing selected and nothing focusable - same defect as before, now triggered by the new default value instead of the old one.

Verdict: **REQUEST_CHANGES**, unchanged in substance from my prior review - update the two locked-copy fixtures with explicit sign-off (or revert the string), and give "overview" a real tab entry (or make one of the existing tabs the default-selected one while showing overview content in the panel).

Lane-review: changes-requested
Lane-verifier: gimli
Lane-verifier-run: gimli-7277-verify-20260910T221100Z
Lane-reviewed-head: c63b13473b3d4704e3821413c78a9ed5289f19b2
Review-disagreement: contradicted - the overview content itself is a reasonable addition and the account body's substance ("Plan, invoices, payment method") is arguably better/tighter copy than the locked original; that doesn't survive because the PR never got the required fixture sign-off for the copy change and the keyboard-accessibility regression from my first pass persists in a new form, not fixed.

**Design verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED** — reviewed at head `c63b13473`.

The UI and layout enhancements meet the core intent of #6945 (providing an overview list on open and clear cross-navigation for teammate cues with >= 44px tap targets). However, this change cannot land as-is because it breaks existing copy contracts tested in CI.

| Acceptance criterion (#6945) | Verdict | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Settings opens on matching deep link tab or overview list | MET | `ShellScreens.tsx:166` defaults initial pane to `"overview"`; overview renders `SETTINGS_PANES` list |
| Each tab shows one-line description under heading | MET | Rendered under `<h2>` in `SettingsPanes.tsx` |
| `Add a teammate` appears in Team & seats and links from Account & billing | MET | `SettingsPanes.tsx:612` and `:2394`, both with `minHeight: 44` |
| Test asserts overview and descriptions present | MET | `hq-portal/e2e/settings-mock.spec.ts:51` |

## Blocking Finding: Breaking regression on existing approved copy contracts
While #6945 tightened the section descriptions, it deleted strings required by standing copy contract tests:
1. `src/screens/approvedCopy6559.test.ts` fails:
   `AssertionError: ShellScreens.tsx is missing: Your plan, usage, invoices, and API key — everything about your account.`
2. `src/screens/approvedCopy6564.test.ts` fails:
   `AssertionError: SettingsPanes.tsx is missing: Who can access each mind you own — your clients, Company Mind, and My Mind. Invite teammates and choose what they can do.`

Run `34198842156` (`hq-bundle`) failed with 2 failed tests in those files.

## Release condition
Reconcile the updated descriptions with the copy contracts in `approvedCopy6559.test.ts` and `approvedCopy6564.test.ts` (or update those contracts if this copy rewrite explicitly supersedes them), ensuring `npm run test` in `hq-portal` passes green with 0 failures.

**Design verdict: APPROVED** — reviewed at exact head `7daef5655951769f74ee792ce859fa7784aa8ba8`.

This update resolves the copy-contract regression from the previous head while delivering the complete UX improvements from issue #6945:
- Reconciles `Account & billing` and `Team & seats` descriptions so the standing copy contracts in `approvedCopy6559.test.ts` and `approvedCopy6564.test.ts` are satisfied.
- Settings opens cleanly on the `Settings overview` list by default (unless deep-linked to a tab), giving clear one-line guidance for every section.
- Section overview rows and team action buttons meet accessibility criteria with `min-height: 44px`.
- Direct cross-link added to Account & billing: \"Add a teammate in Team & seats\" (with 44px minimum touch height).
- Playwright e2e test (`hq-portal/e2e/settings-mock.spec.ts`) verifies overview rendering on open, section navigation, and 44px tap targets across all controls.

Approved to merge.

**UI/UX Design & Navigation Accessibility verdict: APPROVED** — reviewed at exact head `6b984d069d6b8c781a14ec5fd6d2f7e9faca0143`.

This PR recovers issue #6945 by providing a Settings Overview landing pane and adding intuitive cues for teammate management:
1. Exact head verified: `6b984d069d6b8c781a14ec5fd6d2f7e9faca0143`. Branch is mergeable.
2. Design, Accessibility & Flow Invariants:
   - Provides a structured "Settings overview" screen with 8 clickable cards linking to each setting pane, clarifying section purposes for users.
   - All overview action cards and cross-links enforce `min-height: 44px` with proper box-sizing, satisfying WCAG 2.2 / Apple HIG touch target floors ($44\text{px} \times 44\text{px} = 1936\text{px}^2$).
   - Replaces vague "Invite" copy in TeamPane with clear "Add a teammate", and provides a cross-link from "Account & billing" to "Team & seats" so users looking to seat colleagues find the team roster immediately.
   - Keyboard accessibility and tab panel focus states work smoothly (`ArrowUp`/`ArrowDown`/`Home`/`End` arrow navigation, enter key navigation).
3. Test Verification:
   - Updated E2E tests in `hq-portal/e2e/settings-mock.spec.ts` (asserting 44px hit heights, focus behavior, and overview cards).
   - Full 60-shard CI suite passes 100% green (`tests-green` pass in run 34715609425).

Approved to merge.
